orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Grundl Hauler Thrusters, a hull mount (outward is up): two enormous steel bells with rows of big rivets and amber stencil bands, bolted to a heavy riveted base and flanked by strapped fuel cells with chains; the exhaust is a thick orange roar. Inside a core with a rack of three fuel cells (amber labels, valves), a big gear and a ribbed manifold. Damaged: the left bell has a split seam and sputters, a fuel-cell strap snapped and the cell sags, the chain hangs, sparks at the coupling. Disabled: the left bell broken off, the right bent over, the cells fallen, the core dark. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
